title: Valve addresses delays due to higher Steam game submissions
excerpt: Valve reports a significant increase in Steam game submissions, leading to longer review times for developers.
body_html:
Valve has announced it is making changes to address a significant increase in game and store page submissions on Steam over recent months. The company stated that it is currently running behind schedule, with review times taking up to 12 business days instead of the usual three to five days.

The announcement follows recent frustrations expressed by independent developers regarding extended approval wait times on the platform. Valve has not yet detailed the specific changes it plans to implement to clear the backlog and speed up the review process for creators.
